title: ARSIA WebSocket Frame
description: WebSocket control frames for the ARSIA Protocol v1.0. Covers the five frame types defined in ARSIA-Core.md §8.2 (auth, auth_ok, auth_error, ping, pong) and extended by ARSIA-Routing.md §2.2 (dpop_proof on auth, session_id on auth_ok). Discriminated on the type field.

oneOf.description: Authentication request frame — Core §8.2, Routing §2.2.2 Phase 2. The token field contains the full authorization value including the scheme prefix (Bearer or DPoP). For DPoP-bound tokens, dpop_proof contains the DPoP proof JWT (Routing §2.2.2).

token.description: Full authorization value including scheme prefix (Bearer or DPoP) — Core §8.2.

dpop_proof.description: DPoP proof JWT for DPoP-bound tokens — Routing §2.2.2.

oneOf.description: Authentication success frame — Core §8.2, Routing §2.2.2 Phase 2. The agent_id identifies the server. The session_id is a UUID v4 that uniquely identifies this WebSocket session (Routing §2.2.2).

allOf.description: Server's agent identifier — Core §8.2, Core §3.3 Rule 8.
UUID v4 uniquely identifying this WebSocket session — Routing §2.2.2.

oneOf.description: Authentication failure frame — Core §8.2, Routing §2.2.2 Phase 2. After sending this frame, the server MUST close the connection with close code 4001 within 5 seconds.
Heartbeat request frame — Core §8.2, Routing §2.2.2 Phase 4. Client SHOULD send every 30 seconds. Server MUST respond with pong within 5 seconds.
Heartbeat response frame — Core §8.2, Routing §2.2.2 Phase 4. MUST be sent within 5 seconds of receiving a ping.
